# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest FamVoice release receives security fixes. Update before reporting
an issue that affects an older release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through this repository's **Security**
tab by opening a private security advisory. Do not open a public issue or pull
request containing exploit details, credentials, API keys, or personal data.

Include affected version, operating system, reproduction steps, impact, and any
suggested mitigation. You should receive an acknowledgement within seven days.
